Hi Alex / Megan,

Thanks again for taking time today — really helpful to understand FinHealth's priorities around security and compliance as you evaluate Redwood. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- SOC 2: You asked whether Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II — we can share our report and a short summary.
- Pen test: You mentioned you’d like a recent pen test report and details on our vuln management cadence/SLA. We can provide a redacted report under NDA and a written process.
- Vendor questionnaire: I’m attaching a completed vendor questionnaire (Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf) to kick off your internal review; if you have a custom questionnaire we can fill that as well.

Next steps / ask: 
1) Can you confirm who on your side owns vendor risk (security operations / procurement)?
2) Are there specific items we should prioritize in the questionnaire (HIPAA controls, data residency, encryption at rest)?
3) If a redacted pen test report is acceptable, I can loop in Rishi (cc’d) to share the remediation SLA and scanning cadence.

Proposed timeline: we can return the SOC2 summary + redacted pen test within 48 hours once we agree on NDA/receiver for the report.

Attaching: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf; Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-call items — SOC 2, pen test, questionnaire

Hi Alex / Megan — thanks for the clear context. Sharing details below; happy to jump on a call to walk through.

SOC 2
- We maintain a SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-12-31). Summary and control map available here: https://redwood.example/reports/soc2-2026. We can provide a copy of the full report under NDA.

Penetration testing & scanning cadence
- External third-party pen test: last completed 2027-02-10 by SecureProbe Labs (external engagement). Frequency: annual full pen test.
- Continuous scanning: we run nightly authenticated vulnerability scans across infra and weekly SAST in CI for backend services. DAST runs weekly against staging.

Vulnerability management SLA (target remediation windows after triage):
- Critical: patch or mitigation within 48 hours; live mitigations and hotfix process available.
- High: remediation within 7 calendar days.
- Medium: remediation within 30 calendar days.
- Low: tracked in backlog and reviewed per release.

Disclosure and redaction
- We will provide a redacted executive pen test report under a standard NDA. Full reports (with sensitive details) are provided to security contacts upon signed NDA and need-to-know agreement. We follow coordinated disclosure: customers request a CVE or public disclosure through security@redwood.example and we coordinate timelines.

Attachments: PenTest-Process.pdf (vuln triage & remediation flow)

If you want the redacted report, please confirm the recipient and we’ll start the NDA process; otherwise we can share an executive summary immediately.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.example

----
